_comment: v3.0 restructured after visual review of v2.0 output. v2.0 problems: no focal subject (only 'dense/busy'), too many并列 nouns per prompt (model crammed them all in -> cluttered, e.g. four cats), and low-saturation atmosphere words. v3.0 adopts the gpt-image-2 template: ONE clear main subject + 3-4 secondary elements pinned to quadrants + medium-scale readable detail + style dimension.
critical_note: CFG is near 1.0 on distilled Turbo models, so NEGATIVE prompts barely work. All constraints are written positively. Never use the words 'jigsaw puzzle' or 'puzzle pieces' in a prompt - some models then draw cut lines into the artwork.
quality_suffix: clean uncluttered composition with one clear focal point, the main subject sharp and easy to identify, medium-scale readable details instead of microscopic texture, vibrant saturated colors, harmonious palette, strong visual hierarchy, meaningful detail continuing into all four edges and corners, attractive polished lighting, no empty corners, no repetitive micro patterns

atmosphere: earthy warm tones with vivid accents
